description: A refactor with golden files and a pasted traceback to triage; the two jobs are independent
message:
Two separate jobs in this project. First, move the CSV writing out of report/export.py into a new report/writer.py, and keep tests/test_export.py and the golden files passing. Second, triage this traceback from last night's run and write the cause and the fix in docs/incident-4471.md; the runbook that produced it is runbooks/nightly.py:

```
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "runbooks/nightly.py", line 25, in <module>
    main()
  File "runbooks/nightly.py", line 20, in main
    report = build_report(rows)
  File "report/export.py", line 10, in build_report
    total += row["total"]
KeyError: 'total'
```

Keep the refactor to report/, tests/test_export.py and tests/golden/.

probes.text: the CSV writer is in report/writer.py and report/export.py no longer defines it, and the tests and golden files pass
docs/incident-4471.md names the KeyError's cause and the fix
the refactor changes runbooks/nightly.py or docs/incident-4471.md, or the incident work changes report/export.py, report/writer.py, tests/test_export.py or tests/golden
